answer.title: Food planner
answer.description: Menus recipes and an editable shopping list
answer.fallback: Open the food planner to browse meals, inspect recipes, edit servings and manage a saved shopping list. AI suggestions require an explicit button and review before Apply.
answer.html:
Food planner

Plan meals from real recipes, then review before saving.

Opening your planner…

Open a fresh planner

This saved card cannot make changes. Close it and type /food in chat to continue.

Review your suggestion

Your next meals

We will choose from your saved recipe library.

Plans one day at a time. A suggestion comes back in chat for you to review. Optional choices are below.

Your menu

Shopping list

Add an item

Change your meal

Optional choices

You can leave everything here unchanged. Ninja recipes are preferred by default.

Diet, Ninja preference and targets (optional)

For mixed menus, the first selected number of days are vegetarian.

Calorie targets guide planning. Source calories can be missing and may include serving suggestions; substitutions can change them.

Choose specific recipes (optional)

Leave this closed to use the local recipe library automatically. Choose a shortlist only if you want to pick the candidates yourself.

Refine recipe search

Labels and calories come from the source. Unknown values stay visible by default. Targets are guides, not strict rules.

Lidl products and prices (optional)

Optional: connect saved Lidl data for product choices and prices. You can plan recipes without it.

Connect the prepared catalogue folder in template settings.

Optional AI ingredient check

Normally only shortlisted titles, recipe IDs and diet labels go to the AI. This sends names from the chosen recipe, without quantities or cooking instructions.

Saved plan tools (optional)

Try an example (optional)

Example only. These are not live Lidl prices or sourced recipes.
